THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
088
Behind the image
55 / Plaid Collar
REFERENCE 5831.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 041
Art direction: Winter cream with plaid and ruby accents, doll-like romance, flyaway hair in motion.
Photorealistic vertical fashion editorial of an original adult woman with long auburn-brown hair
tied with a red velvet ribbon bow, loose strands blowing across her face, pale blue-gray eyes, rosy
flushed cheeks and soft red-pink lips, looking at the camera with a cool, doll-like expression. She
wears a blue-and-white plaid blouse with a large ruffled Peter Pan collar edged in burgundy
piping, under a cropped cream cable-knit cardigan with puffed sleeves and a matching high-waist
cable-knit flared mini skirt, and carries a pearl-beaded handbag. Soft pale gray studio background,
cream, powder blue and ruby palette, no text or logos.
56 / Winter Square
REFERENCE 5830.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 042
Art direction: Cold-weather glamour, black fur against pale snow, rosy cheeks, landmark backdrop.
Photorealistic vertical smartphone-style travel selfie of an original adult woman with long, straight
blonde hair, blue eyes, rosy wind-flushed cheeks and soft pink lips, looking into the lens with a
calm expression and one black leather-gloved hand held at her chest. She wears a black faux-fur
ushanka hat with ear flaps and a black wool coat over a black turtleneck. Behind her, a wide
snow-covered historic square with a colorful onion-domed cathedral on the left and a red-brick
fortress wall with a tall clock tower on the right, under a heavy gray winter sky with light
snowflakes. Natural cold daylight, black, white and brick-red palette, no text or logos.
